# Title: B2B LinkedIn Marketing by Overseas Marketing
# Description: Official certified LinkedIn Ads Partner providing enterprise LinkedIn outreach, account-based marketing (ABM), profile optimization, and C-level personal branding.

## Organization
- Name: B2B LinkedIn Marketing by Overseas Marketing
- Parent Organization: Overseas Marketing (https://overseas.marketing)
- Headquarters: Istanbul, London, Berlin
- Partnership: Official Certified LinkedIn Ads Partner
- Website: https://b2blinkedin.overseas.marketing/

## Core Services
1. LinkedIn Outreach & AI: Proactive, human-in-the-loop executive outreach targeting verified B2B decision-makers. Adheres strictly to weekly rate limits (100-150 connection requests) to maintain account health.
2. LinkedIn Ads & ABM: Account-Based Marketing campaigns targeting 100-500 named accounts using Matched Audiences, native Lead Gen Forms, and Thought Leader Ads.
3. Profile Optimization: Restructuring executive and founder profiles from chronological CVs into high-ticket sales landing pages engineered for the 5-second test.
4. Company Page Management: Creating corporate credibility, employee advocacy programs, and showcase pages that support outbound prospecting.
5. Content Strategy & Ghostwriting: 45-minute monthly C-level ghostwriting cadence producing case studies and carousel thought leadership.

## Methodologies & Formulations
- BANT & MEDDIC Lead Qualification: Verifying Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline before sales handoff.
- Multi-Threaded ABM: Surrounding buying committees (CFO, CTO, Department Heads) with tailored messaging rather than relying on a single champion.
- 5-Second Test: Within 5 seconds of landing on a profile, executives must discern target segment, guaranteed outcome, and immediate CTA.
